cues.zh: 再用 softmax，把原始輸出，也就是 logits，轉成機率分布。

cues.en: Now that softmax is done over the entire vocab.
cues.zh: softmax 涵蓋整個詞彙表，

cues.zh: 每個 token 都有一個機率，全部加總為 1。

cues.en: Now why do these models use only the last token to predict the next one?
cues.zh: 為什麼模型只用最後一個，預測下一個？

cues.en: It might sound strange when you first hear that statement.
cues.zh: 第一次聽，可能覺得奇怪。

cues.en: I remember being confused when I first heard it as well.
cues.zh: 我第一次聽，也很困惑。

cues.en: It turns out that that's really not true at all.
cues.zh: 其實，並不是如此。

cues.en: The model does not just use the last token to create the next one.
cues.zh: 模型不只是用最後一個 token，建立下一個。

cues.en: Let me now explain why.
cues.zh: 解釋一下。

cues.en: Let's imagine this sentence here.
cues.zh: 想像這個句子：

cues.en: So I prefer oat milk in blank.
cues.zh: I prefer oat milk in，後面留空。

cues.en: The goal for the model will be to take these first five words and predict what word should go in the blank here.
cues.zh: 模型要取前五個字，預測空格該放什麼。

cues.en: Now when the model processes is the first word I.
cues.zh: 處理第一個字 I 時，

cues.en: It doesn't have any context, so it's going to have a really hard time making an accurate prediction of what the next word will be.
cues.zh: 沒有上下文，很難準確預測下一個字。

cues.en: It's still going to try.
cues.zh: 仍然會試，

cues.en: Of course, it's going to use the information in the token embeddings vector to make a prediction about the next word.
cues.zh: 會用 token 嵌入向量中的資訊預測。

cues.en: But yeah, there's like thousands of words that could conceivably come after the word I or the token I.
cues.zh: 但 I 這個字、這個 token 後，可能接幾千種字。

cues.en: But now it's processed the first two tokens so I prefer.
cues.zh: 接著，已處理前兩個 token：I prefer。

cues.en: So now the model is again trying to predict what the next word could be.
cues.zh: 模型再次預測下一個字。

cues.en: Now we still have lots of Of possibilities for what the word could come after.
cues.zh: prefer 後仍有許多

cues.en: Uh, prefer, but I prefer is narrowing down the search space.
cues.zh: 可能，但 I prefer 已縮小搜尋範圍。

cues.en: So there might be tens of thousands of tokens that could come after I.
cues.zh: I 後可能有數萬個 token，

cues.en: And maybe there's only a few thousand tokens that could conceivably come after I prefer.
cues.zh: I prefer 後，也許只剩幾千個。

cues.en: So the model is not just using the word prefer to predict the next word is using the word prefer, and
cues.zh: 所以，不只是用 prefer，還用

cues.en: also what it learned from the word I and the combination of I and prefer.
cues.zh: 從 I，以及 I 與 prefer 組合學到的資訊，預測下一個字。

cues.en: Now the model is processing the word or the token oat, and again it has to make a prediction about what word comes next.
cues.zh: 現在處理 oat 這個字、這個 token，再預測下一個。

cues.en: And again, it's not just predicting the next word based on this token oked it is incorporating what
cues.zh: 同樣，不只根據 oat，還納入

cues.en: it has learned about this context or these other two words here in combination with the embeddings for Oat.
cues.zh: 上下文，或這兩個字的資訊，與 oat 嵌入結合。

cues.en: And then it will use that to try to predict the next token.
cues.zh: 再用來預測下一 token。

cues.en: So now the total search space of tokens that can reasonably follow I prefer Oat is maybe some hundreds.
cues.zh: 因此，I prefer oat 後，合理的 token 可能只剩幾百種。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So we've gotten down from tens of thousands of possibilities to maybe a couple hundred okay.
cues.zh: 從數萬種，縮小到幾百種。

cues.en: I think you're starting to get the idea.
cues.zh: 我想，你開始理解了。

cues.en: So it is kind of true that the model extracts the final token to predict the next token, but it is
cues.zh: 某種意義上，模型確實擷取最後一個 token，預測下一個，

cues.en: not the case that the model is only using that token in all of these steps.
cues.zh: 但不代表所有步驟，都只使用那一個 token。

cues.en: Every one of these token embeddings vectors has been scaled and stretched and added and subtracted to
cues.zh: 每個 token 嵌入向量，都經過縮放、拉伸，以及與

cues.en: each of the other tokens in the sequence, so that by the time we get to this final token, the word in this is not just the embedding for the word in.
cues.zh: 序列中其他 token 相加相減，所以，最後的 in，不再只是 in 的嵌入。

cues.en: This is the combined embeddings of all the words that preceded it in the context, so does the model.
cues.zh: 而是前面所有上下文單字的綜合嵌入。所以，模型是否

cues.en: Only the final token to generate a new one.
cues.zh: 只用最後一個 token 產生新的？

cues.en: The answer is no.
cues.zh: 答案是否定，

cues.en: It absolutely does not.
cues.zh: 絕對不是。

cues.en: In fact, it uses all of the tokens, and all of the information from all of these tokens is loaded onto the final token.
cues.zh: 它使用全部 token，而所有 token 的資訊，都載入最後一個。
